IdempotentReplayed.description: true when this response is the stored one for a repeated Idempotency-Key; absent otherwise

IdempotencyKey.description: Names one action so that a repeat of it (a double click, a retry after a lost reply) runs once. 16 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. The first request under a key runs and, if it succeeds, its response is kept for one calendar day and returned again (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) for the same method, path, query and body from the same caller. The same key with a different request is refused (422). A failure is not kept, so the request can be corrected and sent again under the same key. A key belongs to the caller who made it. Ignored on a read.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IdempotencyInProgress.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running; try again after Retry-After seconds

IdempotencyRefused.description: Validation failure, or the Idempotency-Key is malformed or was used for a different request

ContingentWorkforce.description: Aggregate only: no one is named. Groups below the floor are withheld and no total is given for the funding months.

engagements.description: Engagements ending in separate 30-calendar-day bands, past their end with no decision, extended more than the threshold, and long-running contractors. A count of one to nine is null; no total is given.

trend.description: The contingent share over the snapshots recorded with the split by basis: status ok, or insufficient_history (fewer than three usable dates over at least 60 calendar days) with no points. Older snapshots are unknown, not zero.

DottedLineManager.description: The manager's `pid`, `display_name`, `job_title` and `department` are present when the manager is known.

get.summary: The roles a plan intends the organization to have: key, parent role, department, title and headcount. Roles, never people

put.summary: Replace the plan's target organization: 1 to 2000 roles, unique keys, present parents, no loop, headcount 1 to 10000. There is no way to name a person. Audited in the same transaction

get.summary: The plan's tolerances in time, cost, resources and risk: for each, the deviation now, the limit, and red, amber, green, unknown or not_set, with its basis; and the worst of them. An unknown is never green. Nothing is escalated

put.summary: Set or change a tolerance: limit (0 or more, in calendar days, basis points or roles) and optionally amber_percent (1 to 99, default 75). Audited

get.summary: Advisory working-time guardrails (?department=&as_of=): 17-week 48h average over recorded minutes + 11h rest-gap breaches across recent and planned assignments; flags only, nothing refused (WPM-D19)

post.summary: A read-only Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP, revision 2025-11-25, JSON replies, no session): initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call over ten existing reads. Each tool is one GET route called in process under the caller's own token, so the API's policy decides and a caller without access is refused as on the route. No write tool, no service account. Every tool call is audited with the tool name first; if the audit cannot be written the call is refused. A browser Origin must be listed in WPM_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

get.summary: Prometheus metrics (public)
